{"effort": "high", "extra": {}, "messages": [["user", "## Scenario

Monthly merchandise export values and commodity group shares by destination economy, 2021-2023

The National Directorate of Statistics compiled customs trade declaration summaries from January 2021 through December 2023 to monitor structural shifts in merchandise export composition and evaluate national trade exposure across major trading partner economies.

## Columns

| Column | Kind | Declared as |
|---|---|---|
| `broad_sector` | category | Manufactured Goods, Commodities & Energy, Agri-Food; group merchandise |
| `destination_market` | category | United States, European Union, China, Japan; group geography |
| `export_share_pct` | measure | unit percent; non-additive |
| `export_value_usd_m` | measure | unit million USD; additive |
| `product_group` | category | Electronics & Machinery, Automotive & Transport, Chemicals & Plastics, Refined Petroleum, Mineral Ores, Processed Food, Raw Agricultural Goods; within broad_sector; group merchandise |
| `quarter` | category | 2021-Q1, 2021-Q2, 2021-Q3, 2021-Q4, 2022-Q1, 2022-Q2, 2022-Q3, 2022-Q4, 2023-Q1, 2023-Q2, 2023-Q3, 2023-Q4; ordered=ordinal; derived from report_month; group calendar |
| `report_month` | time | 2021-01-01 to 2023-12-31, monthly; group calendar |
| `yoy_share_change_ppt` | measure | unit percentage points; non-additive |

## Figures

- `f01`
    p0: bar, grouped by destination_market, AVG(export_share_pct), unit percent
    p0 reads destination_market off the axis tick
    drawn to answer: Which destination markets and broad sectors command the highest average export share
- `f02`
    p0: line, grouped by report_month, SUM(export_value_usd_m), unit million USD
    p0 reads report_month off the axis tick
    drawn to answer: How total merchandise export value developed across report months over the three-year series
- `f03`
    p0: scatter, grouped by nothing, NONE(export_share_pct, yoy_share_change_ppt), unit percent, percentage points
    drawn to answer: Whether product groups with larger overall export shares experience higher year-on-year share volatility
- `f04`
    p0: bar, grouped by destination_market, AVG(export_share_pct), unit percent
    p0 reads destination_market off the axis tick
    p1: bar, grouped by destination_market, SUM(export_value_usd_m), unit million USD
    p1 reads destination_market off the axis tick
    the panels are related by: dual_metric
- `f05`
    p0-p2 each: bar, grouped by destination_market, AVG(export_share_pct), unit percent
    p0-p2 each reads destination_market off the axis tick
    p0 is titled 'Manufactured Goods'
    p1 is titled 'Commodities & Energy'
    p2 is titled 'Agri-Food'
    the panels are related by: small_multiples
- `f06`
    p0: bar, grouped by destination_market, AVG(export_share_pct), unit percent
    p0 reads destination_market off the axis tick
    p1: bar, grouped by broad_sector, AVG(export_share_pct), unit percent
    p1 reads broad_sector off the axis tick
    p2: bar, grouped by product_group, AVG(export_share_pct), unit percent
    p2 reads product_group off the axis tick
    p3: bar, grouped by quarter, AVG(export_share_pct), unit percent
    p3 reads quarter off the axis tick
    the panels are related by: facet
- `f07`
    p0: bar, grouped by destination_market, AVG(export_share_pct), unit percent, labelled '2021-01-01 to 2022-06-17'
    p0 reads destination_market off the axis tick
    p0: category_line, grouped by destination_market, AVG(export_share_pct), unit percent, labelled '2022-06-18 to 2023-12-01'
    p0 reads destination_market off the axis tick
    the panels are related by: overlay_slice
- `f08`
    p0: bar, grouped by destination_market, AVG(export_share_pct), unit percent, labelled 'AVG'
    p0 reads destination_market off the axis tick
    p0: error_bar, grouped by destination_market, FIVE_NUM(export_share_pct), unit percent, labelled 'spread'
    p0 reads destination_market off the axis tick
    the panels are related by: overlay_range
- `f09`
    p0: bar, grouped by destination_market, AVG(export_share_pct), unit percent, labelled 'AVG(export_share_pct) [percent]'
    p0 reads destination_market off the axis tick
    p0: category_line, grouped by destination_market, SUM(export_value_usd_m), unit million USD, labelled 'SUM(export_value_usd_m) [million USD]'
    p0 reads destination_market off the axis tick
    the panels are related by: overlay_metric
- `f10`
    p0: bar, grouped by destination_market, AVG(export_share_pct), unit percent
    p0 reads destination_market off the axis tick
    the panels are related by: drilldown
- `f11`
    p0: grouped_bar, grouped by destination_market, broad_sector, AVG(export_share_pct), unit percent
    p0 reads destination_market off the axis tick, broad_sector off the legend
    the panels are related by: drilldown
- `f12`
    p0: pie, grouped by broad_sector, COUNT(*)
    p0 reads broad_sector off the inline label
- `f13`
    p0: table_chart, grouped by product_group, COUNT(*)
    p0 reads product_group off the inline label
- `f14`
    p0: bar, grouped by broad_sector, MIN(export_share_pct), unit percent
    p0 reads broad_sector off the axis tick
- `f15`
    p0: windsock, grouped by report_month, FIVE_NUM(export_share_pct), unit percent
    p0 reads report_month off the axis tick
- `f16`
    p0: heatmap, grouped by quarter, broad_sector, MIN(yoy_share_change_ppt), unit percentage points
    p0 reads quarter off the axis tick, broad_sector off the axis tick

## What to write

| Field | Content |
|---|---|
| `title` | What the figure shows. Name the quantity and how it is broken down |
| `subtitle` | The qualifier: what each mark covers, over what period |
| `unit` | The unit the values are in, as it would be written on an axis |
| `column_names` | One readable name per column below, used on axes and in legends |

Columns to name: `broad_sector`, `destination_market`, `export_share_pct`, `export_value_usd_m`, `product_group`, `quarter`, `report_month`, `yoy_share_change_ppt`

Rules: no numbers except years and quarters; no findings, comparisons or
directions; no chart-type words; `title` at most 48 characters and `subtitle` at
most 60, counted as characters rather than words because that is what has to fit
across the width of the image.

## The previous answer was rejected
